caption: The drawing shows a circular object with a geometrical, kaleidoscope-like pattern in the center, featuring concentric rings of blue, brown, white, and green shapes. The circle is bordered by a red-brown band with a stitched white diamond pattern. Attached to the circle are three large, prominent red bows: one at the top, one on the left side, and one below the circle. Two red ribbons are looped through the top bow, connecting it to the bow beneath it and the circular object. The background is plain and cream-colored. There is a small unfinished pencil sketch of an elliptical object in the upper left corner, and hand-written text in the lower left and right corners of the drawing.
title: Pincushion
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
